context_and_flow.ux_intent: To collect personal information from the user as part of a multi-step signup process.
ux_patterns: The progress indicator at the top uses simple icons (envelope, person, location marker) with blue highlighting for the active step.
The design is highly focused on user input with a clear, large CTA button.
High contrast between the dark background and the light text/blue accents.
